intro: The Vivid chair has an exceptional place in the legacy of our brand featuring a classic design that blends well with modern yet simple furniture pieces. With a cool colour range and apt materials, it is a very comfortable chair that never gets old.

features.title: Elegant design that speaks volumes
features.text: A chair that instantly lifts the vibe of your workspace with its rich, clean finish and subtle sheen.

features.title: Comfort you can sink into
features.text: Its cantilevered base and gently contoured backrest bring together style and comfort, so long hours feel a little easier.

features.title: Perfect for compact spaces
features.text: Designed to be compact and armless, it fits in seamlessly, saves space, and moves wherever you need it.

features.title: Effortless Maintenance
features.text: Wrapped in easy-to-maintain leatherette, it stays looking fresh and new with minimal effort.

name: Vivid Ergonomic Leatherette Cantilever Chair Set Of 4 Blue
